messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Grouped measure invariance
parts:
Someone posted the same feature request on github, where you can read my response about how to do obtain that output.

https://github.com/simsem/semTools/issues/31

I would not advise getting too attached, though.  I think automatically providing tests of all levels of invariance could inadvertently promote bad practice (e.g., why test full scalar invariance if there is evidence against metric invariance? Need to fix that first...), so I will probably require users to test one level at a time, or at least stop when the earliest test does not pass.  But I will probably not get a chance to update (and integrate!) the measurementInvariance() suite of functions for about a year.
